items.information: Attendance is not required for the entire competition. However, please arrive at least **15 minutes** before your event's planned start time. Please bring your own puzzles for the events you are competing in. ## First-Time Competitors: All newcomers must be familiar with the WCA Regulations before competing. There is a video [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww) for a basic overview of the rules. ## Implementation of 4-Pad The World Cube Association has announced that as of January 2nd, 2027, all timed attempts must use a Speed Stacks G5 StackMat™ Pro Timer in 4-pad mode, as opposed to the previous 2-pad mode. This competition will be the first in Alberta to do so. You can read the WCA's announcement [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/adoption-of-4-pad-timing-august-2026). ## Notice of Filming and Photography: Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information: 🇧🇷 **Português** Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GurizaoemOsorio2027/register). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazê-lo [neste vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410). Para esse campeonato, teremos modalidades acontecendo simultâneamente. O competidor deverá escolher entre **7x7 OU SKEWB** e **6x6 OU PYRAMINX** Por favor, caso você se inscreva mas decida não ir ao campeonato, por favor nos informe para que possamos programar corretamente a quantidade de competidores. O competidor poderá se inscrever em quantas modalidades desejar. Pedimos que não se inscreva nas modalidades que não possui intenção de participar. É imprescindível ter lido as regras da WCA (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). 🇺🇸 **English** Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GurizaoemOsorio2027/register) tab. If you have any problem registering, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410). For this competition, we will have events happening simultaneously. The competitor must choose between **7x7 OR SKEWB** and **6x6 OR PYRAMINX**. Please, if you register but decide not to come for the competition, please let us know so we can better figure out the number of competitor's to expect. The competitor can register for every event that he wants, we just ask to not register to events you're not certain at participating. Every competitor must have read WCA's Rules (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

items.name: Dobřejovice Special 2027
items.information: # ENGLISH **Mandatory Competition tutorial** All competitors are required to complete the official competitor tutorial before being allowed to participate in the competition. This requirement applies to everyone, not only newcomers. Competitors who do not attend the tutorial will not be permitted to compete. **Special Competition Format** This competition will be held using a special format in which all events run simultaneously. Each competitor will have a 35-minute cumulative limit to complete attempts in any events they choose. Each competitor in blindfolded events will have a 3-hour cumulative limit to complete attempts in any events they choose. # ČESKY **Povinný tutoriál pro soutěžící** Všichni závodníci musí před začátkem soutěže absolvovat oficiální tutoriál. Tato povinnost platí pro všechny, nejen pro nováčky. Závodníkům, kteří se tutoriálu nezúčastní, nebude umožněno soutěžit. **Speciální formát soutěže** Tato soutěž bude probíhat ve speciálním formátu, ve kterém všechny disciplíny běží zároveň. Každý soutěžící má k dispozici 35 minut, během kterých může skládat libovolné disciplíny podle vlastního výběru. Každý soutěžící v disciplínách poslepu má k dispozici 3 hodiny, během kterých může skládat libovolné disciplíny podle vlastního výběru.
